vachanas.kannada:
ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾನಂದವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಾಂಕುರವ ಮೆಲಿದು
ಆನಂದವೆಂಬ ಜಲವನೀಂಟಿ
ಸಮತೆಯೆಂಬ ನೆಳಲಲ್ಲಿರ್ಪುದ ನೆನೆಯಾ ಮನವೆ!
ಮಹಾಮಂತ್ರ ಶಿವಧ್ಯಾನವನೆ ಸವಿದು,
ಮೆಲುಕುತ್ತಿರ್ಪುದು.
ಧರ್ಮಾರ್ಥಕಾಮಮೋಕ್ಷವೆಂಬ ಮೊಲೆ ತೊರೆಯಲು
ಹಂಪೆಯ ವಿರುಪನ ಕರೆವ ಕಾಮಧೇನು
ಪಂಚಾಕ್ಷರಿಯೆಂಬುದು.
vachanas.transliteration:
bhaktyānandavanadalli jñānāṅkurava melidu
ānandavemba jalavanīṇṭi
samateyemba neḷalallirpuda neneyā manave!
mahāmantra śivadhyānavane savidu,
melukuttirpudu.
dharmārthakāmamōkṣavemba mole toreyalu
hampeya virupana kareva kāmadhēnu
pan̄cākṣariyembudu.
vachanas.translation:
In the garden of blissful devotion, the sprout of knowledge has arisen.
Watered by the stream of bliss,
It remains under the shade called equanimity—O mind, contemplate this!
It relishes the great mantra and the meditation of Shiva,
And continually chews upon and reflects on them.
When the udders called Dharma, Artha, Kama, and Moksha are milked,
The wish-fulfilling cow of Virupa of Hampi,
Is the Panchakshari mantra (“Namah Shivaya”).

vachanas.kannada:
ವಿಪುಳ ವೇದವೇದಾಂತಸಾರ, ಸಕಲಲೋಕಜನಹಿತಾಧಾರ,
ಸಪ್ತಕೋಟಿ ಮಹಾಮಂತ್ರಂಗಳ ತವರುಮನೆ, ಭಕ್ತಜನಜೀವಾನಂದ,
ಅಖಿಳಾಗಮ ಸಂತಾನದ ಹರಣ, ಮುಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣ ಸೋಪಾನ,
ಪ್ರಣವಾಂಕುರ ಪಲ್ಲವ ಫಲರೂಪು, ತ್ರಿಣಯನೊಲಿಸುವ ಕರ್ಣಾಭರಣ,
ಹರನ ನಾಮದ ಸಾಕಾರದ ನಿಲವು, ಪರಮಪಂಚಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾನಂದ,
ಪರತತ್ತ್ವದ ನಿತ್ಯದ ನೆಲೆ,
ಹಂಪೆಯ ವಿರುಪನ ತೋರುವ ಗುರು ಪಂಚಾಕ್ಷರಿ.
vachanas.transliteration:
vipuḷa vēdavēdāntasāra, sakalalōkajanahitādhāra,
saptakōṭi mahāmantraṅgaḷa tavarumane, bhaktajanajīvānanda,
akhiḷāgama santānada haraṇa, muktige kāraṇa sōpāna,
praṇavāṅkura pallava phalarūpu, triṇayanolisuva karṇābharaṇa,
harana nāmada sākārada nilavu, paramapan̄cabrahmānanda,
paratattvada nityada nele,
hampeya virupana tōruva guru pan̄cākṣari.
vachanas.translation:
The vast essence of the Vedas and Vedanta,
The foundation of the welfare of all beings in all worlds,
The native abode of seventy million great mantras,
The life-bliss of devotees,
The destroyer of all bondage according to the Agamas,
The ladder that leads to liberation,
The form of the sprout, tender shoot, and fruit of Pranava (Om),
The ear-ornament that delights the Three-Eyed Lord,
The manifest abode of Hara’s holy name,
The bliss of the Supreme Panchabrahmas,
The eternal abode of the Supreme Reality—
Is the Guru Panchakshari revealed by Virupa of Hampi.

vachanas.kannada:
ಹುಸಿಯ ನುಡಿಯನು ಭಕ್ತ, ವ್ಯಸನಕ್ಕೆಳಸನು ಭಕ್ತ,
ವಿಷಯಂಗಳಾತಂಗೆ ತೃಣವು ನೋಡಾ, ಬಯಸುವವನಲ್ಲ ಭಕ್ತ.
ದಯೆಯೆಂಬುದು ತನ್ನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯೆಂಬುದು ತನಗೆ
ತೊತ್ತಾಗಿಪ್ಪುದು.
ಕೋಪವೆಂಥದೆಂದರಿಯ, ತಾಪತ್ರಯಂಗಳು ಮುಟ್ಟಲಮ್ಮವು,
ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಗಳಡಗಿದವು.
ಲಿಂಗವನೊಳಕೊಂಡ ಪರಿಣಾಮಿ.
ಆತನ ಪಥ ಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸತು, ಲೋಕದ ಪಥವಾತನಿಗೆ ಹೊಸತು.
ತನಗೊಮ್ಮೆಯು ಲಿಂಗಧ್ಯಾನ, ಲಿಂಗಕೊಮ್ಮೆಯು ತನ್ನ ಧ್ಯಾನ.
ಘನಘನಮಹಿಮೆಯ ಹೊಗಳಲೆನ್ನಳವಲ್ಲ.
ಪನ್ನಗಧರ ಕೇಳಯ್ಯಾ, ಚೆನ್ನ ಹಂಪೆಯ ವಿರುಪಯ್ಯಾ,
ನಿಮ್ಮ ನಂಬಿದ ಸತ್ಯಶರಣ ಪರಿಣಾಮಿ.
vachanas.transliteration:
husiya nuḍiyanu bhakta, vyasanakkeḷasanu bhakta,
viṣayaṅgaḷātaṅge tr̥ṇavu nōḍā, bayasuvavanalla bhakta.
dayeyembudu tanna kaiyalli, smaraṇeyembudu tanage
tottāgippudu.
kōpaventhadendariya, tāpatrayaṅgaḷu muṭṭalam'mavu,
vyāptigaḷaḍagidavu.
liṅgavanoḷakoṇḍa pariṇāmi.
ātana patha lōkakke hosatu, lōkada pathavātanige hosatu.
tanagom'meyu liṅgadhyāna, liṅgakom'meyu tanna dhyāna.
ghanaghanamahimeya hogaḷalennaḷavalla.
pannagadhara kēḷayyā, cenna hampeya virupayyā,
nim'ma nambida satyaśaraṇa pariṇāmi.
vachanas.translation:
A devotee does not speak falsehood.
A devotee does not become enslaved by addictions.
To him, worldly objects are but blades of grass.
A devotee is not one who craves desires.
Compassion rests in his hand.
Remembrance of the Lord remains ever attached to him.
He knows not what anger is.
The threefold afflictions cannot touch him.
All limitations have subsided within him.
He has become one established in the Linga.
His path is new to the world.
The world's path is new to him.
His sole contemplation is the Linga.
The Linga’s contemplation is upon him.
My words are inadequate to praise his immense glory.
Listen, O Serpent-bearing Lord!
O Virupayya of beautiful Hampi!
Such is the accomplished true Sharana who has placed his faith in you.

vachanas.kannada:
ಹಂಸಪತಿ ಗರುಡಪತಿ ವೃಷಭಪತಿ
ಮೊದಲಾದ ಸರ್ವಜೀವಾಧಿಪತಿ
ದೇವರಾಯ ಮಹಾರಾಯನ ಅರಸುತನ ಹೊಸತು:
ಓಲಗಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾರ, ಸಿಂಹಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳ್ಳಿರ,
ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಂಪಟನಾಗಿ ಅಂತಃಪುರವ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೊರವಂಡ.
ಕಪ್ಪಕಾಣಿಕೆಯನೊಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಬವರಿಲ್ಲ,
ಗುರುವೆಂಬ ತಳವಾರನ ಆಜ್ಞೆ ಕೆಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು,
ತೆರೆದ ಬಾಗಿಲ ಮುಚ್ಚುವರಿಲ್ಲ,
ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಬಾಗಿಲ ತೆರೆವವರಿಲ್ಲ.
ಹಂಪೆಯ ವಿರುಪಯ್ಯನ ಅರಸುತನ ಕೆಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು,
ಭಕ್ತರೆಂಬವರಿನ್ನು ಬದುಕಲೇ ಬಾರದು.
vachanas.transliteration:
hansapati garuḍapati vr̥ṣabhapati
modalāda sarvajīvādhipati
dēvarāya mahārāyana arasutana hosatu:
ōlagakke bāra, sinhāsanadalli kuḷḷira,
strīlampaṭanāgi antaḥpurava biṭṭu horavaṇḍa.
kappakāṇikeyanoppisikombavarilla,
guruvemba taḷavārana ājñe keṭṭittu,
tereda bāgila muccuvarilla,
muccida bāgila terevavarilla.
hampeya virupayyana arasutana keṭṭittu,
bhaktarembavarinnu badukalē bāradu.
vachanas.translation:
The Lord of swans, the Lord of Garuda, the Lord of the Bull,
The sovereign of all living beings,
Possesses a kingship unlike that of earthly emperors and mighty monarchs.
“Come to the royal court; sit upon the throne,” they say.
Yet he has abandoned the inner chambers and gone forth.
There is no one to receive tribute or taxes.
The command of the watchman called Guru has been neglected.
No one closes the open doors.
No one opens the closed doors.
The kingdom of Virupayya of Hampi has fallen into disorder.
Such that those called devotees can scarcely continue to live.
